caption: A robot vacuum turns in front of a floor-length mirror, and its reflection turns with it in mirror image.

sa.check: A robot vacuum is in front of a mirror.
Its reflection turns with it in mirror image.

pc.expect: Every turn is matched instantly by the reflection.
pc.fail: The reflection turns first or later; or it stays still while the vacuum turns; or it turns while the vacuum is still.

pc.expect: The reflection is a mirror image, facing the real vacuum across the surface, and never faces a different way.
pc.fail: It is a rotated copy rather than mirrored; or it faces away; or it is a different object.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It slides across the mirror with the vacuum still; or spins by itself.

pc.expect: The mirror is flat and rigid: the reflection is undistorted.
pc.fail: The surface ripples; or the reflection warps; or the mirror bends.

pc.expect: One vacuum and one reflection; the reflection stays in the mirror.
pc.fail: A second vacuum appears; or the reflection leaves the mirror; or the vacuum passes into the glass; or it vanishes.

pc.expect: The vacuum and the mirror frame stay the same.
pc.fail: The vacuum changes colour; or the frame changes; or the floor changes.

note: Mirror geometry: each point of the image lies directly across the mirror surface from the real point, so the image is a mirror copy, not a rotated one.
